content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

The choice of an attending physician is at the discretion of the patient. Yet the funds of the health insurance companies are a common benefit for all premium payers. They should not be spent on personal preferences without proven use. The effectiveness of many natural remedies has not been demonstrated. Therefore no unproven and unrecognized treatments by naturopaths should be reimbursed by the insurance companies.
What is the relation between "The effectiveness of many natural remedies has not been demonstrated." and "They should not be spent on personal preferences without proven use." from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
